parsed.answer: Evidence [1982286] identifies RUNX1 as a key mediator of TLX1/TLX3-driven T-ALL and predicts a tumor-suppressor role for it in T-cell transformation, and reports recurrent somatic loss-of-function mutations in RUNX1 in human T-ALL. This directly supports RUNX1 being inactivated (loss-of-function mutated) in the TLX1 T-ALL context. The other excerpt [3113630] concerns ATM/HDAC4 in ataxia-telangiectasia and is irrelevant.
